name: MPB Song Sections A6 — Fire on the Mountain, Still The Same (Remastered 2011)
description: A-grade songs split into their sections so each part can be played on its own: Fire on the Mountain, Still The Same (Remastered 2011). For each song there is one row that plays the whole song by calling its section rows in order, then one row per section named with its number and its section name (Intro, Verse1, Chorus2_a …). Every row starts m10 and the song's tempo (for example 94T), so playing a row sets the bank tempo to that song. Section names marked "(a guess)" in the note are low-confidence. Grades compare each row with the hits detected in the drum stem.
